...Oh wow, we're really on the page. Is
your
passion contagious or something?
Ewww...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm kidding! I don't mind matching
your
vibes once in a while. Actually, it's
pretty great.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, wanna go and celebrate? We
can get
something tasty!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I won, so why are you so serious? It's
extra typical
of you. Aren't you happy?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Then just say so. Tell me I did good and
then
make me better!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not talking about next time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I deliberately avoid laying the praise on
too thick.
Tosen Jordan appears fired up
and eager to earn
more compliments
next time.
